text: 🇲🇽🌎 The state remittance card beats every bank. "For a US$400 transfer, Mexico's public Finabien card delivers 6,892.09 pesos — the best exchange rate on the market, above every commercial operator." — Profeco, "Quién es Quién en los Precios" Finabien is the government-run remittance system. Profeco's weekly price watch showed it remains the cheapest way for migrants to send money home from the United States.

🇲🇽✊ Welfare isn't charity — it's the economy. "It's direct support not only for the people, but also for the economy. It will let us keep lifting millions and millions of Mexicans out of poverty." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on the Bienestar programs Welfare Secretary Leticia Ramírez reported roughly 42.8 million beneficiaries by the end of 2026, backed by close to 1 trillion pesos a year: pensions for 13.7M seniors, 2M people with disabilities, women aged 60–64, plus 23 million home health visits.

🇲🇽🌎 Trump drapes North America in the US flag. Sheinbaum: Mexico is not and will never be a colony. "In the month of the homeland, we reaffirm that Mexico is not and will never be a colony or protectorate of any foreign country." — Claudia Sheinbaum, September 7, 2026 Trump posted a map of North America covered by the US flag, labeling the Gulf of Mexico "Gulf of America." Sheinbaum answered the next day, in the middle of Mexico's independence month.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Fobaproa: the bank bailout Mexicans will "never finish paying"</u>

Sheinbaum is dedicating a special mañanera to the Fobaproa after a new Finance Ministry study reached a damning verdict: the 1990s bank rescue that Zedillo turned into public debt "will never be paid off," because every year only the interest gets covered while the principal is rolled over with fresh debt. Three decades on, the people still carry the cost of private banks' losses.

text:
🔥🇲🇽 <u>Hacienda schools The Economist over Mexico's economy</u>

When The Economist claimed markets had lost faith in Mexico, Hacienda came back with receipts, calling the piece "selective" and outdated: Mexico holds investment grade with all eight agencies that rate its debt (seven on stable outlook), the spread over US Treasuries has narrowed from 193 to 170 basis points since Sheinbaum took office, and the deficit was cut from 5.8% to 4.3% of GDP — "the largest adjustment in decades."

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Foreign direct investment hits a record $34.97 billion</u>

Mexico pulled in a record 34,968 million dollars in FDI in the first half of 2026 — the highest ever for a January–June period, up 2.1% year-on-year, with the US alone accounting for 48.2%. The nuance El Economista flags: 88.5% is reinvested earnings, companies already here doubling down, while brand-new capital was just 2,726 million. The confidence is real; the task now is turning it into new plants and jobs.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Morena: Vicente Fox is regrouping the old "mafia del poder"</u>

The PRIAN's greatest hits are getting back together for 2027. Morena flagged ex-president Vicente Fox's parade of meetings with the PAN, with "Alito" Moreno's PRI (received at PRI headquarters) and the Somos front as "a reorganization of the mafia del poder" — the same forces that "look like adversaries but unite when power and privileges are at stake." Fox is selling it as a "renewed" citizen alternative.
banner: FOX REGROUPS THE OLD POWER MAFIA

text:
🇲🇽🇺🇸 <u>"Cooperation always, subordination never": Sheinbaum draws the line with the US</u>

From Monterrey, Sheinbaum told the neighbor to the north exactly where the border of dignity runs: "Cooperation always, subordination never — that is the essence of Mexicans." She wants a good relationship with Trump's Washington, but "cooperation does not mean submission; friendship does not mean renouncing our principles. While I am president, I will defend our sovereignty, our dignity and our independence with all firmness."

🇲🇽🇨🇳 <u>China backs Mexico's sovereignty against foreign interference</u>

While Washington threatens tariffs and floats "military options" against cartels, Beijing went the other way: meeting Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco, China's Wang Yi voiced support for "Mexico's independence and autonomy... and its opposition to foreign interference," stressing that China–Mexico ties "are not directed at third parties and should not be affected by third parties." Velasco announced a new Mexican consulate in Chongqing.

<u>US MEDIA — SILENCE</u>: Mexico's 581-km Mexico City–Guadalajara passenger train
September 6, 2026 | 🇲🇽

🇲🇽 Sheinbaum announced construction begins in 2027 on a 581-km passenger railway linking Mexico City to Guadalajara through five states — part of a national rail revival abandoned for a generation. US mainstream coverage: zero. 📰

The same outlets that cover every cartel bombing had nothing on a multi-year public infrastructure project crossing Hidalgo, Querétaro, Guanajuato and Jalisco.
